plugs.name: network
plugs.purpose: Required for outbound network access to cloud platforms via MQTT/TLS and HTTPS

plugs.name: network-bind
plugs.purpose: Required to bind local network services: MQTT broker on 127.0.0.1:1883 and web UI on 127.0.0.1:8888

plugs.name: system-observe
plugs.purpose: Required to monitor system resource usage for health reporting and watchdog service

plugs.name: log-observe
plugs.purpose: Required to read service logs via journalctl for log collection and upload to cloud

plugs.name: hardware-observe
plugs.purpose: Required to read device serial number via DMI for unique device identity management

plugs.name: mount-observe
plugs.purpose: Required to read mount point information for disk usage reporting in the web UI

plugs.name: removable-media
plugs.purpose: Optional access to external storage for configuration and log file operations

plugs.name: snapd-control
plugs.purpose: Required for snap list command to report all installed snaps in software inventory

slots.name: package-assets
slots.purpose: Provides app metadata and configuration files to the ctrlX Device Admin app

slots.name: package-certificates
slots.purpose: Provides access to device certificates and keys for TLS cloud connectivity

slots.name: package-run
slots.purpose: Provides Unix socket directory for ctrlX reverse proxy web UI integration

slots.name: datalayer
slots.purpose: Provides access to ctrlX Data Layer nodes for cloud telemetry forwarding
